anomalies.observed: Net /NET0007, which drives servo header J1 pin 3 through R24, is tied to bus pins J4/J6-20 and J4/J6-22 via R19 and R11. Net /NET0017, which drives servo header J2 pin 3 through R17, is tied to bus pins J4/J6-19 and J4/J6-21 via R18 and R2.
anomalies.expected: Per the specification, channel 1 (intended J3, actual J1) should use bus pins 19/21, and channel 2 (intended J8, actual J2) should use bus pins 20/22. Therefore /NET0007 should connect to pins 19/21 and /NET0017 to pins 20/22.

evidence.quote: Select which M5Stack bus pin (pin 19/21 for ch.1, pin 20/22 for ch.2) supplies PWM1/PWM2

anomalies.impact: When PWM mode is assembled, the pan and tilt servo channels are swapped relative to the intended M5Stack bus pin mapping. Firmware that expects channel 1 on bus pins 19/21 will drive the wrong physical servo header.

parsed.summary: The design is functionally consistent with the specification except that the PWM bus-pin selection for the two servo channels is swapped: /NET0007 (servo header J1) uses bus pins 20/22, while /NET0017 (servo header J2) uses 19/21, contrary to the spec's mapping of channel 1 to 19/21 and channel 2 to 20/22.
